summary.headline: Stellar Effects at Nativity
summary.text: Astrological delineations of stars rising or culminating at nativity: Gemini stars of Mars temperament, Scorpio’s northern claw and the Twins’ leading star of Jupiter-Mercury temperament, and Orion, Procyon, and the Horse-Andromeda star, with differing effects in diurnal and nocturnal births.
